description: The bar chart compares the performance of different language models on the RedWhale dataset, with the x-axis representing the model names and the y-axis representing the performance metric. The chart shows that the PT-EVAL model has the lowest performance, while the KoBEST-SN model has the highest performance. The average performance of all models is also shown, with a value of 0.61. The chart also includes a comparison of the performance of the KoBEST model in different configurations, with the KoBEST-BQ model having the lowest performance and the KoBEST-HS model having the highest performance.
